title: Fable suggested opening a prop firm account
author: Headjacked
selftext: I used Fable to setup an automated trading system. Last night it suggested I open a prop firm account. Is this a thing that people do? The setup I have it said would be a good match to pass an evaluation. My coworkers and family don't trade or mess with AI.

comments.author: jaw_line
comments.body: Spend another month learning what you are doing at the very least bro

comments.author: Headjacked
comments.body: I appreciate the reply. Wondering if I can use my automated trading build on a prop firm.not sure what kind of experience needed for that

comments.author: Headjacked
comments.body: A little more context. I built an automated trading system since I work market hrs. I just had fable build the program. The system is automated with several LLM's learning trades. I also have a few that vote on the conviction score before sending me the setup. So it's a program not AI trading it.

replies.body: So you created an algo, did you backtest the algo in good amount of time (5yrs Minimum to confirm if the algo have edge) also if you want to confirm if your strategy it’s good for propfirm just make backtest with the rules of the propfirm….

replies.body: I didnt base this off of any strategy. I'm teaching them how to trade the market. They are now running a 24/7 loop of training. I have been able to trade on Coinbase, Alpaca, Schwab.. Fable made a prop firm evaluation

comments.body: Ask Fable, if with a maximum allowed drawdown of $2,000, what are the odds it will make at least $3,000 in less than a month? Or, with $2,000 max drawdown allowed, how long on average does it take to reach $3,000 profit?

replies.body: I have to wait an hr for reset. Right now reads low confidence, after the suggestion. We added an eval readiness tab to my website. Just bought a ThetaData subscription to get 3 yrs. of historical options data to cram this weekend. I gave him an end goal of 80% pass rate on a typical funded account eval. I built it just to manage a Schwab and Public account because I work market hrs. My biggest problem is getting him to be aggressive, so instead it said what I built would be perfect to run a funded account. That's where I'm at now.. What size account?

replies.author: Headjacked
replies.body:
Today, with the record as measured: the corrected tape has every strategy family net-negative (best case roughly −0.1 to −0.3R/day). At that edge the odds of hitting +$3,000 before the $2,000 drawdown eats you are ~1–3%, and "how long on average" has no meaningful answer — the average path never gets there; it busts. The median-days numbers only describe the rare lucky survivors.

The full table (3,000 sims per cell, straight from eval_lab.simulate; "md" = median trading days for the paths that do pass):

Daily edge	$150/R	$250/R	$400/R
Today's tape (−0.3R/day)	1%	2%	3%
Zero edge (coin flip)	3%	34% (md 29)	28%
Modest edge (+0.2R/day)	29% (md 44)	55% (md 31)	51%
Strong edge (+0.5R/day)	86% (md 34)	96% (md 21)	55%
